{

   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Robust Linear Models"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:13.732103Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:13.731939Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:14.609620Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:14.609036Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:14.615144Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:14.614861Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.770275Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.769691Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation\n",
    "\n",
    "Load data:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.773591Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.773323Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.793279Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.792645Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "data = sm.datasets.stackloss.load()\n",
    "data.exog = sm.add_constant(data.exog)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Huber's T norm with the (default) median absolute deviation scaling"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.795601Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.795459Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.827323Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.824699Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "const       -41.026498\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.829384\n",
      "WATERTEMP     0.926066\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.127847\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "const        9.791899\n",
      "AIRFLOW      0.111005\n",
      "WATERTEMP    0.302930\n",
      "ACIDCONC     0.128650\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "                    Robust Linear Model Regression Results                    \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   No. Observations:                   21\n",
      "Model:                            RLM   Df Residuals:                       17\n",
      "Method:                          IRLS   Df Model:                            3\n",
      "Norm:                          HuberT                                         \n",
      "Scale Est.:                       mad                                         \n",
      "Cov Type:                          H1                                         \n",
      "Date:                Mon, 05 Oct 2026                                         \n",
      "Time:                        11:13:15                                         \n",
      "No. Iterations:                    19                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          z      P>|z|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "var_0        -41.0265      9.792     -4.190      0.000     -60.218     -21.835\n",
      "var_1          0.8294      0.111      7.472      0.000       0.612       1.047\n",
      "var_2          0.9261      0.303      3.057      0.002       0.332       1.520\n",
      "var_3         -0.1278      0.129     -0.994      0.320      -0.380       0.124\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "If the model instance has been used for another fit with different fit parameters, then the fit options might not be the correct ones anymore .\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "huber_t = sm.RLM(data.endog, data.exog, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT())\n",
    "hub_results = huber_t.fit()\n",
    "print(hub_results.params)\n",
    "print(hub_results.bse)\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    hub_results.summary(\n",
    "        yname=\"y\", xname=[f\"var_{i}\" for i in range(len(hub_results.params))]\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Huber's T norm with 'H2' covariance matrix"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.915870Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.915624Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.930129Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.929790Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "const       -41.026498\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.829384\n",
      "WATERTEMP     0.926066\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.127847\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "const        9.089504\n",
      "AIRFLOW      0.119460\n",
      "WATERTEMP    0.322355\n",
      "ACIDCONC     0.117963\n",
      "dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "hub_results2 = huber_t.fit(cov=\"H2\")\n",
    "print(hub_results2.params)\n",
    "print(hub_results2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Andrew's Wave norm with Huber's Proposal 2 scaling and 'H3' covariance matrix"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.932107Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.931883Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.963455Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.963049Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Parameters:  const       -40.881796\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.792761\n",
      "WATERTEMP     1.048576\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.133609\n",
      "dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "andrew_mod = sm.RLM(data.endog, data.exog, M=sm.robust.norms.AndrewWave())\n",
    "andrew_results = andrew_mod.fit(scale_est=sm.robust.scale.HuberScale(), cov=\"H3\")\n",
    "print(\"Parameters: \", andrew_results.params)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "See ``help(sm.RLM.fit)`` for more options and ``module sm.robust.scale`` for scale options\n",
    "\n",
    "## Comparing OLS and RLM\n",
    "\n",
    "Artificial data with outliers:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.966521Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.966294Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.971938Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.971652Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "sig = 0.3  # smaller error variance makes OLS<->RLM contrast bigger\n",
    "beta = [5, 0.5, -0.0]\n",
    "y_true2 = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y2 = y_true2 + sig * 1.0 * np.random.normal(size=nsample)\n",
    "y2[[39, 41, 43, 45, 48]] -= 5  # add some outliers (10% of nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Example 1: quadratic function with linear truth\n",
    "\n",
    "Note that the quadratic term in OLS regression will capture outlier effects. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.973830Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.973628Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.981007Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.980673Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 5.13535499  0.49888969 -0.0107129 ]\n",
      "[0.45303718 0.06994283 0.00618886]\n",
      "[ 4.86753242  5.11310226  5.35510262  5.59353349  5.82839489  6.05968681\n",
      "  6.28740925  6.51156221  6.73214568  6.94915968  7.1626042   7.37247923\n",
      "  7.57878479  7.78152086  7.98068746  8.17628457  8.36831221  8.55677036\n",
      "  8.74165903  8.92297823  9.10072794  9.27490817  9.44551892  9.6125602\n",
      "  9.77603199  9.9359343  10.09226713 10.24503048 10.39422435 10.53984874\n",
      " 10.68190365 10.82038908 10.95530502 11.08665149 11.21442848 11.33863599\n",
      " 11.45927401 11.57634256 11.68984163 11.79977121 11.90613132 12.00892194\n",
      " 12.10814309 12.20379475 12.29587694 12.38438964 12.46933286 12.55070661\n",
      " 12.62851087 12.70274565]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res = sm.OLS(y2, X).fit()\n",
    "print(res.params)\n",
    "print(res.bse)\n",
    "print(res.predict())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Estimate RLM:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.982708Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.982412Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.995617Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.995335Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 5.07131712e+00  4.84516521e-01 -6.07927231e-04]\n",
      "[0.13917324 0.02148647 0.00190122]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "resrlm = sm.RLM(y2, X).fit()\n",
    "print(resrlm.params)\n",
    "print(resrlm.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Draw a plot to compare OLS estimates to the robust estimates:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.998645Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:15.998343Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.226201Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.224482Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7f0b7bb101a0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1200x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))\n",
    "ax = fig.add_subplot(111)\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y2, \"o\", label=\"data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true2, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "pred_ols = res.get_prediction()\n",
    "iv_l = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_lower\"]\n",
    "iv_u = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_upper\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, res.fittedvalues, \"r-\", label=\"OLS\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_u, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_l, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, resrlm.fittedvalues, \"g.-\", label=\"RLM\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Example 2: linear function with linear truth\n",
    "\n",
    "Fit a new OLS model using only the linear term and the constant:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.227904Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.227733Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.236888Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.236274Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[5.56715057 0.39176066]\n",
      "[0.38596128 0.03325598]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "X2 = X[:, [0, 1]]\n",
    "res2 = sm.OLS(y2, X2).fit()\n",
    "print(res2.params)\n",
    "print(res2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Estimate RLM:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.238431Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.238279Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.252199Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.251664Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[5.09269422 0.47917562]\n",
      "[0.11296237 0.00973329]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "resrlm2 = sm.RLM(y2, X2).fit()\n",
    "print(resrlm2.params)\n",
    "print(resrlm2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Draw a plot to compare OLS estimates to the robust estimates:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.256345Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.256180Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.605999Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T11:13:16.598010Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "pred_ols = res2.get_prediction()\n",
    "iv_l = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_lower\"]\n",
    "iv_u = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_upper\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y2, \"o\", label=\"data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true2, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, res2.fittedvalues, \"r-\", label=\"OLS\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_u, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_l, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, resrlm2.fittedvalues, \"g.-\", label=\"RLM\")\n",
    "legend = ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  }
 ],
